Hexagonal architecture. Domain innermost, application defines ports, infrastructure provides adapters. Layer order DOMAIN, APPLICATION, INFRASTRUCTURE, CONTROL. No cross-layer dependencies. Port flow outbound to inbound. Severity: every CU is CRITICAL unless the CU content downgrades it explicitly.

# DTR-COORDINATES: 

CU means Computational Unit. A CU content block carries REQUIREMENTS, COORDINATES, IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS and ACCEPTANCE. Each numbered step names an exact file path, carries a fenced code block when it changes a file, and ends with a Prove line naming the exact command. Do NOT touch lists what this CU must not modify. Stop when is the exit condition.

REQUIREMENTS:
Deliver bugfix-feature-7 Phase 2 acceptance criteria 6-9. Thread the run-level accumulated written-paths set (run_written) into wave measurement so a wave never re-attributes files written by earlier waves of the same run as unattributed breaches. wave_writes gains a prior_written exclusion set and subtracts it; enforce_boundary forwards it; run_wave_parallel accepts it and all four enforcement call sites pass it; main_async supplies frozenset(run_written) and the redundant run_written re-annotation is removed. Add regression tests. Follow ARCH.PYTHON.*: explicit annotations at first binding, no typing.Any, no bare generics, no try/except for expected failures.

```python
class TestPriorWrittenExclusion(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_wave_writes_drops_prior_written(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
            root: Path = Path(raw)
            git: list[str] = ["git", "-C", str(root)]
            subprocess.run(git + ["init", "-q"], check=True)
            (root / "tracked.txt").write_text("one\n")
            subprocess.run(git + ["add", "tracked.txt"], check=True)
            subprocess.run(
                git + ["-c", "user.email=a@b.c", "-c", "user.name=t",
                       "commit", "-q", "-m", "base"], check=True)
            (root / "tracked.txt").write_text("two\n")
            (root / "created.txt").write_text("new\n")
            found: Sequence[str] = RUNNER.wave_writes(
                root, "HEAD", frozenset(), frozenset({"tracked.txt"}))
            self.assertNotIn("tracked.txt", found)
            self.assertIn("created.txt", found)

    def test_enforce_boundary_ignores_prior_written_guard(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
            root: Path = Path(raw)
            git: list[str] = ["git", "-C", str(root)]
            subprocess.run(git + ["init", "-q"], check=True)
            (root / "guarded.txt").write_text("one\n")
            subprocess.run(git + ["add", "guarded.txt"], check=True)
            subprocess.run(
                git + ["-c", "user.email=a@b.c", "-c", "user.name=t",
                       "commit", "-q", "-m", "base"], check=True)
            (root / "guarded.txt").write_text("two\n")
            feedback: Path = root / "feedback"
            logs: Path = root / "logs"
            feedback.mkdir()
            logs.mkdir()
            guards: dict[str, object] = {
                "cu-004": parse_no_touch(
                    "Do NOT touch: guarded.txt\nStop when x\n"),
            }
            writes: Sequence[RUNNER.CoderWrites] = (RUNNER.CoderWrites(cu_id="cu-004", paths=()),)
            clear: Sequence[RUNNER.BoundaryBreach] = RUNNER.enforce_boundary(
                writes, root, "HEAD", frozenset(), guards, feedback, logs,
                frozenset({"guarded.txt"}))[0]
            self.assertEqual(clear, ())
            phantom: Sequence[RUNNER.BoundaryBreach] = RUNNER.enforce_boundary(
                writes, root, "HEAD", frozenset(), guards, feedback, logs)[0]
            self.assertEqual(len(phantom), 1)
            self.assertEqual(phantom[0].rule, "unattributed:cu-004")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

Prove: `cd /home/kcat/Repos/llm-driven-design && python3 -m unittest discover -s .LLMDD/tests -p test_cu_boundary.py 2>&1 | tail -3`

Do NOT touch: any DTR file, any ITR frame file, any ITR frame or feedback file, any Scala source
Stop when the runner parses, prior_written is threaded through all four enforcement sites, and the full test_cu_boundary.py suite passes with the two new tests.

ACCEPTANCE:
P2-T1 wave_writes drops a path listed in prior_written while retaining an untracked path not in it; proven by TestPriorWrittenExclusion.test_wave_writes_drops_prior_written.
P2-T2 enforce_boundary with a prior-written guarded path produces no unattributed breach, while the same path without the exclusion still does; proven by TestPriorWrittenExclusion.test_enforce_boundary_ignores_prior_written_guard.
P2-T3 the full test_cu_boundary.py suite passes with zero failures and zero errors.
P2-T4 prior_written appears in wave_writes, enforce_boundary, run_wave_parallel and all four enforcement call sites; main_async passes frozenset(run_written); the redundant run_written re-annotation is gone; ast.parse succeeds on both edited files.
